# bergamot-translator (vendored)

- `bergamot-translator.js`: Emscripten glue generated by mozilla/translations `inference/scripts/build-wasm.py`,
  taken from mozilla-central `toolkit/components/translations/bergamot-translator/bergamot-translator.js`
  (moz.yaml: release v0.6.0, revision eea6e5a80aa4ddd86d9cc35ce9a65b79aa3ab96d; the file embeds
  `BERGAMOT_VERSION_FULL = "v0.6.0+eea6e5a8"`). License MPL-2.0 (see LICENSE).
  SHA-256: faff1ef6285b0d26f01787776fd49299dfb756ecb9688aa990c250e66797b47d (100,187 bytes). Not modified.
- The matching wasm (`bergamot-translator-v0.6.0.wasm`, 4,960,506 bytes,
  sha256 a3a89d9ad0a4ed8f27bf3e403701b23f5709816f6376438503f2fa5b0182c2dc) is downloaded by
  `scripts/prepare-model-assets.mjs` from Firefox Remote Settings
  (`translations-wasm` record release v0.6.0, revision 1de4a085d3a7afb625c51a60aabb5ad298e4059f) and is not committed.
- `translator-worker.js`: CheckMates' own classic Worker (MPL-2.0 compatible, this repo's license applies),
  modelled on Firefox `translations-engine.worker.js` (AlignedMemory alignments 256/64/64, same Marian config).
- Models: Mozilla `translations-models` en→zh-Hans v2.2 (base-memory), MPL-2.0, downloaded by the same script.
